## Features

- 🎨 Multiple output styles (default, official account, Juejin, dark mode)
- 📝 Live preview, what you see is what you get
- 📋 One-click HTML copy, paste directly into an account/blog post
- 💾 Export as an HTML file
- 🔧 Supports GFM syntax, code highlighting, and math formulas
